title: RAG Spider — Web to Markdown for AI Input Configuration
description: Configuration for the enterprise-grade RAG Spider web crawler and document intelligence engine.

startUrls.title: Start URLs
startUrls.description: List of URLs where the crawler will start. Supports Apify requestListSources format.
startUrls.sectionDescription: Configure target websites, depth limits, sitemap discovery, and crawling boundaries

crawlDepth.title: Crawl Depth
crawlDepth.description: Maximum depth to crawl from starting URLs. Set to 1 to crawl only start URLs, 2 to include one level of links.

includeUrlGlobs.title: Include URL Patterns
includeUrlGlobs.description: Optional glob patterns to limit crawling scope. Example: ['https://docs.example.com/**']

excludeUrlGlobs.title: Exclude URL Patterns
excludeUrlGlobs.description: Glob patterns for URLs to exclude from crawling. Example: ['**/tag/**', '**/author/**']

sitemapDiscovery.title: Enable Sitemap Discovery
sitemapDiscovery.description: Automatically discover and parse sitemaps from robots.txt and /sitemap.xml

respectRobotsTxt.title: Respect robots.txt
respectRobotsTxt.description: Follow robots.txt directives and crawl-delay instructions

maxRequestsPerCrawl.title: Max Requests Per Crawl
maxRequestsPerCrawl.description: Maximum number of pages/documents to process in a single crawl run

requestDelay.title: Request Delay (ms)
requestDelay.description: Delay between requests in milliseconds to respect target servers

maxConcurrency.title: Max Concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: Maximum number of parallel browser tabs/requests

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Proxy settings for the crawler to avoid rate limiting and IP blocks

enabledFormats.title: Enabled Document Formats
enabledFormats.description: List of document formats to ingest and parse
enabledFormats.sectionDescription: Enable multi-format parsing for documents, office files, and tables

enableReadability.title: Enable Readability Filtering
enableReadability.description: Strip navigation, sidebars, headers, and boilerplate using Mozilla Readability

enableImageMetadata.title: Extract Image & Diagram Metadata
enableImageMetadata.description: Extract image dimensions, alt text, captions, and detect technical diagrams

enableStructuredData.title: Extract Structured Data (JSON-LD, OG)
enableStructuredData.description: Extract OpenGraph, Twitter Cards, Schema.org JSON-LD entities, and canonical URLs

preserveCodeBlocks.title: Preserve Code Blocks & Syntax
preserveCodeBlocks.description: Preserve syntax fences, language annotations, and prevent code mutilation

preserveTables.title: Preserve Data Tables
preserveTables.description: Preserve structured Markdown tables and tabular data

chunkingStrategy.title: Semantic Chunking Strategy
chunkingStrategy.description: Algorithm used to partition documents into RAG-ready chunks
chunkingStrategy.sectionDescription: Select RAG-optimized chunking strategy and token limits

chunkSize.title: Chunk Size (Characters)
chunkSize.description: Maximum number of characters per chunk for RAG processing

chunkOverlap.title: Chunk Overlap (Characters)
chunkOverlap.description: Number of characters to overlap between consecutive chunks to preserve context

maxChunkTokens.title: Max Chunk Tokens
maxChunkTokens.description: Upper token ceiling for each chunk to protect LLM context windows

preserveHeadings.title: Preserve Heading Hierarchy
preserveHeadings.description: Include ancestral heading context in each chunk

enableQualityScoring.title: Enable Content Quality Scoring
enableQualityScoring.description: Calculate deterministic quality scores (0-100) and letter grades (A+ to F)
enableQualityScoring.sectionDescription: Transparent 0-100 quality scoring and automated 13-point dataset health checks

qualityThreshold.title: Quality Acceptance Threshold
qualityThreshold.description: Minimum score required for a page to be marked as acceptable quality

enableDeduplication.title: Enable Duplicate Detection
enableDeduplication.description: Detect exact page duplicates and perceptual SimHash near-duplicate chunks

enableDatasetValidation.title: Enable Dataset Validation
enableDatasetValidation.description: Validate 13+ production criteria (broken sequences, empty chunks, missing metadata)

crawlMode.title: Crawl Mode
crawlMode.description: Select crawl execution mode (full recrawl vs incremental conditional requests)
crawlMode.sectionDescription: Avoid recrawling unchanged pages and detect line-by-line content diffs

enableContentFingerprinting.title: Enable Content Fingerprinting
enableContentFingerprinting.description: Generate SHA-256 and SimHash fingerprints for state tracking

enableChangeDetection.title: Enable Content Change Detection
enableChangeDetection.description: Detect added/removed lines and modified sections relative to previous snapshots

enableVersionHistory.title: Persist Version Snapshots
enableVersionHistory.description: Store historical document snapshots in Key-Value Store for future diffing

enableLanguageDetection.title: Enable Language Detection
enableLanguageDetection.description: Automatically detect document language (50+ languages supported)

targetLanguages.title: Target Languages Filter
targetLanguages.description: Optional ISO 639-1 language codes to allow. Leave empty to accept all languages.

exportFormat.title: Vector DB Export Format
exportFormat.description: Select primary export format for Key-Value Store vector database payloads
exportFormat.sectionDescription: Export directly to leading vector databases and JSONL/CSV formats in Key-Value Store

exportBatchSize.title: Export Batch Size
exportBatchSize.description: Number of chunks per export batch

generateDashboard.title: Generate Visual Analytics Dashboard
generateDashboard.description: Generate standalone Dark Fintech HTML report saved to Key-Value Store key OUTPUT
generateDashboard.sectionDescription: Generate standalone dark fintech HTML report under Key-Value Store key OUTPUT

dashboardTheme.title: Dashboard Theme
dashboardTheme.description: Theme for the visual analytics dashboard

maximumDownloadSize.title: Max Download Size (Bytes)
maximumDownloadSize.description: Maximum allowed file download size in bytes (default 10 MB)

enableDetailedLogging.title: Enable Detailed Logging
enableDetailedLogging.description: Print verbose debug logs during crawl execution
